footnotes: aModeled cohort: women aged 49 years starting neoadjuvant chemotherapy for stage II or III triple-negative breast cancer in Japan (Table 1). Costs in JPY 1,000 at fiscal year 2026 prices, discounted at 2% per year over a lifetime horizon; the strategies with exercise include the fee-schedule-based program (JPY 192,400). Strategies are listed in order of total cost. Increments are against the strategy in the comparator column: the next cheaper strategy on the frontier, or, for a dominated strategy, the strategy that dominates it. A strategy is dominated when another costs less and gives more QALYs. Net monetary benefit is the QALYs gained valued at JPY 5 million per QALY minus the incremental cost, relative to chemotherapy alone.
